## The rule

Quote the current sentence in `architecture.md` (section and
subsection), or state the new rule in the guideline's voice.

## What changes

The sentence as it should read.

## Why

What went wrong, or what became possible, in a real system. Facts over
preferences.

## Lenses affected

Lens ids that restate this rule (see `lenses/`), or "new lens".
